_meta.purpose: Structured registry of Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Areas of Interest (AoIs). A CSO is a standing framework; the AoIs issued under it carry the actual scope, NAICS, evaluation criteria and due dates. Before this file those AoIs lived only as prose inside contracts.json descriptions, which made them unsearchable, unrenderable and impossible to date-check.
_meta.refresh_rule: No cron writes this file. Re-verify each open AoI against SAM.gov / the issuing office on a cadence and bump its last_verified. Never bump last_verified without an actual current source - an unverified date is worse than an honestly old one.
_meta.parent_link: Every entry's parent_slug MUST match a slug in contracts.json. scripts/validate-cso-aois.js enforces this.

csos.title: DHA Enterprise-Wide Commercial Solutions Opening
csos.issuing_office: DHA Contracting Activity (DHACA) / Defense Healthcare Management Systems Contracting Division (DHMS-CD)
csos.scope_note: Usable by any current or future PAE or PMO across the DHA enterprise: Medical Digital Solutions, Medical Services, Medical Products.
csos.aoi_watch_note: First AoI posted: HT003826SC005-AOI0001 (AWACS, end user services for PAE Medical Digital Solutions), presolicitation August 14 2026, solicitation September 10 2026, white papers due September 14 2026; the notice archived September 29 2026 with no award posted on SAM.gov as of the October 19 2026 check. The CSO announcement itself establishes only the procedures and was last modified on SAM.gov September 30 2026; the Government may post, extend or revise AoIs at any time, and each one sets its own authority, problem statement, evaluation criteria, submission criteria and anticipated time to award.

aois.title: PAE Medical Digital Solutions End User Services (EUS): Application, Workflow, Adoption, and Change Support (AWACS)
aois.instrument: FAR-based contract (for example FAR Part 12) or prototype Other Transaction agreement under 10 U.S.C. 4022; a 12-month base plus four 12-month options anticipated, per the SAM.gov notice
aois.note: First requirement competed under the enterprise CSO. PAE MDS (PEO DHMS renamed in July 2026) is moving end user services for its portfolio from legacy labor-intensive support contracts to a unified outcome-based delivery model across 11 user domains and 8 service pillars, briefed at the June 18 2026 industry day. White papers were due by email September 14 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT; the Q&A posted September 10 2026. No award was posted on SAM.gov as of the October 19 2026 check. MMT analysis: Capture Corner, September 4 2026.

csos.title: PEO DHMS Commercial Solutions Opening (Innovative Healthcare IT Solutions)
csos.scope_note: Predecessor CSO scoped to PEO DHMS rather than the DHA enterprise. Superseded in breadth by HT003826SC005.
csos.aoi_watch_note: AoIs 1b through 4 are carried over from verified contracts.json coverage as of the 2026-08-17 re-verification pass; AoI 6 added from SAM.gov on 2026-10-19. The base CSO notice (HT0038-25-S-C001, SAM.gov bc2b02f206b2455a8bcd2664402451f6) stated it would remain open until July 1 2026 and archived July 16 2026. AoI 3 established the prototype-to-production precedent now available enterprise-wide under HT003826SC005.

aois.title: AI / ML / Natural Language Processing
aois.note: Proposals due July 1, 2026, with awards expected December 2026. Response window has closed; award not yet announced as of the last review.

aois.title: Healthcare Delivery (Operational Medicine Care Delivery Platform)
aois.note: Awarded November 19, 2025 under CSO HT0038-25-S-C001, period of performance through 2030. Tracked in detail as its own listing entry.

aois.title: Ambient Listening (DAX Copilot)
aois.note: The precedent-setting AoI. A successful CSO prototype transitioned directly to production task orders under the DHMSM/HCDS IDIQ with no new competitive recompete. That prototype-to-production path is the reason this CSO family matters more than its individual dollar values.

aois.title: Data Applications
aois.note: Cancelled amid the McKinsey task order dispute. The underlying requirement remains valid, so this scope is a candidate to resurface as an AoI under the enterprise-wide CSO.

aois.title: Autonomous Coding and Denials Management Services
aois.note: Competed under CSO HT003825SC001 for prototype OTAs under 10 U.S.C. 4022; white papers were due March 9 2026 (Revision 1 lowered the impact level to IL4; Revision 2 named the support contractors). SAM.gov notice HT003826X0006 states the AoI was cancelled in its entirety on August 3 2026 because the Government requirement changed.

csos.title: PEO DHMS Innovation Solutions CSO
csos.scope_note: NAICS 541618. Tracked because DHA is migrating discrete, project-scoped work off the Workforce 3.0 IDIQ into this CSO and HT003825SC001. OCI mitigation is a defined Phase 1a proposal element rather than a bar to entry.
csos.aoi_watch_note: Responses accepted through January 28, 2027. Individual Program Requirement notices issued under the CSO on SAM.gov: HT003826SC001-01 (February 6 2026, responses due February 19 2026), HT003826SC001-02 (March 11 2026, due February 23 2026 as listed), HT003826SC001-03 (published March 20 2026, proposals due April 16 2026, Q&A posted April 2 2026, notice archived September 1 2026). Awards under them are not recorded in this registry.
